column1: # Provisional game profile of Chained Echoes (Switch, base game v0 + update v1310720 + the Ashes of Elrant DLC), Unity 2020.3.36f1 IL2CPP, SDK 14.3.0, NVN. Written from a survey of
# the game files with dm/games/profile_guess.py; booted on Android only (an AYN Thor, the opening), with the pool measured there. Every key marked "guess" follows a rule or a sibling
# profile and is not measured. README.md beside this file.
# guess: a 2D role-playing game moved with the stick or the D-pad; the 3D layout has the D-pad. Nothing in the files decides it
# The display version was not read (the import keeps no control data)
# load order as on Horizon: main, subsdk0, sdk. subsdk0 is NintendoSDK_movie: main takes 25 functions from it (movie::Extractor, movie::Decoder: Unity's video player), none of which
# the file every Unity player has (as the other Unity profiles); profile_guess.py's rule would name the largest file, a music bundle
# the file types that are big or already compressed (profile_guess.py's rule)
# The NPDM declares 16 MB of system resource, so there is virtual address memory: nninitStartup hands pool - used to StandardAllocator as one address region (it returns to
# main+0x322910) and Unity reserves its own regions beside it. The block is profile_guess.py's 5 GB one (256 MB in front + 4.375 GB alias region + 256 MB stack region + 128 MB heap
# region), not measured against another. The pool is measured on an AYN Thor (2026-11-16): with 1 GB (the first guess, from the other Unity 2020.3 profiles) the pool was full 4.6 s
# after the start (eight refused MapPhysicalMemory at 0.93 GB mapped) and the game crashed at main+0x813a3c before its first picture; with 2 GB (Advance Wars 1+2: Re-Boot Camp's)
# the title, a new game and the first two scenes run with 1.75 GB mapped at most, the alias region used up to +3.51 GB of 4.38 GB, and no refusal. README.md has the runs
# ---- Shader split (shader_split.py; Unity Shader objects, read by unityfs.py) ----

# guess (Fire Emblem Engage's groups, the other Unity 2020.3 game with Addressables): engine built-ins (Resources/) go to engine, the Addressables bundles to assets, the player's serialized files to data
# PEANUTS begin: picture shapes, untested candidates (aspect_plan, dm/host/aspect_plan.h): Game settings > Display > Fill
# NOT SEEN ON A DEVICE. Every place the ? pack's main has the packed 1920x1080 sizes in code and the 16/9 float words (a scan of the code on 2026-11-21, no community patch behind them):
# the 3D view may follow the screen, the 2D layer may not, or the game may draw wrongly or not start with Fill. Fit is unchanged. Take out the
# rows that prove wrong, and aspect_plan_untested once a device has shown the rest right (the note says what was seen).
